items.actClause: AN ACT to amend chapter 118 of the laws of 1969, relating to a separate union free school district in the town of Greenburgh, in the county of Westchester, in relation to clarifying the authority of the Greenburgh North Castle Union Free School District to lease certain properties and to expand its boundaries
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S4241              REVISED 04/03/13

TITLE  OF  BILL:    An  act  to amend chapter 118 of the laws of 1969,
relating to a separate union free  school  district  in  the  town  of
Greenburgh,  in  the  county of Westchester, in relation to clarifying
the authority  of  the  Greenburgh  North  Castle  Union  Free  School
District to lease certain properties and to expand its boundaries

PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

The  purpose  of this bill is to authorize the Greenburgh North Castle
union free school district to lease  properties  for  the  purpose  of
providing instruction to students in the Greenburgh North Castle union
free school district.

SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section  2-c  is  added  to  chapter  118  of  the  laws of 1969 which
clarifies the authority of the  Greenburgh  North  Castle  Union  Free
School  District  to  lease  properties  and to expand its boundaries.
Section 2-c of the bill authorizes the Greenburgh North  Castle  union
free  school  district,  subject  to  approval  of  the New York State
education department, to lease properties located at 45 East Gainsborg
Avenue in the village of West Harrison, county of Westchester and  100
North  Broadway in the village of Irvington, Westchester County and to
enter into any agreements necessary to lease the  properties  for  the
purpose  of  educating  the  students enrolled in the Greenburgh North
Castle union free school district.

JUSTIFICATION:

This legislation is necessary to allow  the  Greenburgh  North  Castle
Union Free School District to lease properties and expand their school
boundaries.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill - 2013

EFFECTIVE DATE:

This act shall take effect immediately.

B.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S4241B

TITLE OF BILL:  An act to amend chapter 118 of the laws of 1969,
relating to a separate union free school district in the town of
Greenburgh, in the county of Westchester, in relation to clarifying
the authority of the Greenburgh North Castle Union Free School
District to lease certain properties and to expand its boundaries

PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL: The purpose of this bill is to
authorize the Greenburgh North Castle union free school district to
lease properties and expand its boundaries for the purpose of
providing instruction to students in the Greenburgh North Castle union
free school district.

SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section 2-a authorizes the lease and expansion of boundaries of
properties located at 108 Shonnard Place in the city of Yonkers,
county of Westchester, and at 1700 Old Orchard Place in the village of
Valhalla, county of Westchester for the purpose of providing
instruction to students enrolled in the school district.

Section 2-b authorizes the lease and expansion of boundaries of
properties located at 623 Blooming Grove Turnpike, in the town of New
Windsor, county of Orange, to be known as the Kaplan Center Academy
for the purpose of providing instruction to students enrolled in the
school district.

Section 2-c of the bill authorizes the Greenburgh North Castle union
free school district, subject to approval of the New York State
education department, to lease properties and expand boundaries of
properties located at 45 East Gainsborg Avenue in the village of West
Harrison, county of Westchester to be known as the REACH Academy and
to enter into any agreements necessary for the purpose of providing
instruction to students enrolled in the Greenburgh North Castle union
free school district.

Section 2-d authorizes the lease and expansion of boundaries of
properties located at 100 North Broadway in the village of Irvington,
county of Westchester to be known as the Greenburgh Academy and to
enter into any agreements necessary to lease the properties for the
purpose of educating the students enrolled in the Greenburgh North
Castle union free school district.

JUSTIFICATION: This legislation is necessary to allow the Greenburgh
North Castle Union Free School District to lease properties and expand
their school boundaries.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY: New Bill - 2013

EFFECTIVE DATE: This act shall take effect immediately.
